$comment: Realistic founder questions, including deliberately vague ones.
`expect` is the set of categories a good answer may come from — several are
legitimately multi-category, so this is a set rather than one value.
A query passes when at least 2 of the top 3 results fall inside the set.
`needs` is informational: the need keys the planner is expected to resolve to.
`repoQueries` assert specific repos rather than categories: `anyOf` needs one of them in
the top 3 of the answer, `allOf` needs all of them there, `never` must not appear at all.
`llmNeeds` replays a model-written plan as [label, search phrase] pairs, so the path the
live site takes is tested without an API key.
